Item Sync Overrides
fields.description: D14 gates for DigiTax send. St. Austin defaults: require Digitax Item Name ON, require manual sync ON, auto-sync OFF.
When ON, every SI line Item must have Digitax Item Name; DigiTax receives that name only (never ERP item name).
fields.label: Require Digitax Item Name

fields.description: When ON, DigiTax send blocks unless Item already has custom_digitax_id (manual Sync to Digitax).
fields.label: Require Manual Item Sync

fields.description: When ON, missing DigiTax IDs may be auto-created/reused by display name during send. Not for St. Austin default.
fields.label: Auto Sync Items to Digitax
